lead: Three watchlist names reported over the past 24 hours, with Aurum Resources leading on high-grade drilling results at Boundiali, alongside a new drilling start from Maritana Minerals and a routine capital structure filing from Orezone.
subtitle: Aurum extends high-grade gold outside the resource at Boundiali as Maritana begins drilling near Black Swan.
watch_items: AUE: next Boundiali resource update targeted for end of Q3 CY2026, ahead of a DFS due late CY2026
MRT: assay results from the Wilsons Gold aircore program expected late September or early October 2026
day_in_brief: Aurum Resources returned assays from 36 diamond holes (9,452m) across BMT3, BMT2 and BMT1 at its 3.22Moz Boundiali Gold Project in Côte d'Ivoire, with the standout intercept 1.76m @ 150.87g/t Au from 485.94m, including 0.72m @ 367.05g/t Au, at BMT3, extending mineralisation outside the current resource. Maritana Minerals commenced a 4,000 metre aircore drilling program at Wilsons Gold, approximately 400m from its Black Swan Processing Hub, testing gold potential beneath a 2.5km by 1.5km gold-in-soil anomaly where past rock chips graded up to 1.25g/t Au and historical drilling returned 0.4m @ 6.41g/t Au. Orezone's Appendix 4A showed CDIs on issue at 43,352,323 as at end July 2026, down 834,900 from 44,187,223 the prior month, reflecting net transfers to TSX-quoted common stock, which rose to 624,750,667; options over 400,000 shares expiring 16 July 2026 were exercised during the period. No quarterlies were reported in the window.

summaries.heading: Aurum extends high-grade gold at BMT3, Boundiali
summaries.body: Aurum Resources has returned assays from 36 diamond holes (9,452m) across BMT3, BMT2 and BMT1 at its 3.22Moz Boundiali Gold Project in Côte d'Ivoire. The standout intercept was 1.76m @ 150.87g/t Au from 485.94m, including 0.72m @ 367.05g/t Au, at BMT3, with mineralisation extending outside the current resource. Results will feed into the next Boundiali resource update, targeted for the end of Q3 CY2026, ahead of a DFS due late CY2026.

summaries.heading: Maritana starts drilling at Wilsons Gold, 400m from Black Swan hub
summaries.body: Maritana Minerals has commenced a 4,000 metre aircore drilling program at the Wilsons Gold Prospect, located approximately 400m from its Black Swan Processing Hub. The program is the first drilling to test gold potential beneath a 2.5km by 1.5km gold-in-soil anomaly, where past rock chips graded up to 1.25g/t Au and historical drilling returned 0.4m @ 6.41g/t Au. Assay results are expected in late September or early October 2026.

summaries.heading: Monthly CDI count edges down as holders shift to TSX common stock
summaries.body: Orezone's routine Appendix 4A shows CDIs on issue at 43,352,323 as at end July 2026, down 834,900 from 44,187,223 the prior month, reflecting net transfers between CDIs and TSX-quoted common stock. Common stock on issue rose to 624,750,667. Options over 400,000 shares expiring 16 July 2026 were exercised during the period.
